messages:
Rosa Kim: opened a docs PR to align audit examples with our SOC2 guidance and add a safe export flow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978 
Priya Shah: thanks Rosa. paste the sample payload you want in the doc so legal can eyeball it quickly? :mag:
Rosa Kim: here's the minimal payload I added to the PR (no PII):
```json
{
  \"name\": \"user.authenticated\",\n  \"tenant\": \"t-4444\",\n  \"time\": \"2026-05-05T08:00:00Z\",\n  \"actor\": { \"kind\": \"svc\", \"id\": \"svc-01\" },\n  \"attrs\": { \"pseudonym_id\": \"pid-1234\", \"location\": \"[redacted]\" }\n}
```
Notes: explicit pseudonym_id, location redacted, removed email/phone fields.
Nikhil Agarwal: I'll update the JS/Rust examples in the SDK snippets to reference pseudonym_id and parse `name` instead of the legacy key. Also adding a tiny compatibility helper that falls back to legacy keys.
Samir Patel: recommend emitting `X-Redwood-Deprecation: audit_key` header when we accept the old key for a transition period (60 days). Add a brief changelog entry in the PR.
Legal - Compliance: suggested retention language: "Standard retention for audit records is 90 days; customers may request extended retention by contract. Legal-hold requests take precedence over retention TTLs." Please avoid terms implying indefinite storage. Also: include a short note about how to request a legal hold and link to the evidence playbook and export docs.
Rosa Kim: I'll add a one-paragraph FAQ: "Can I send emails/phones in audit webhooks?" -> "No. Replace PII with pseudonym identifiers or tokens; contact support for migration assistance."
Priya Shah: SOC2 reviewers usually want explicit examples for exports that show redaction in practice. Could we add a curl export example that demonstrates redacting keys at export time?
Nikhil Agarwal: added a curl snippet to the PR showing redact options and output preview:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/export" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\"from\":\"2026-01-01\",\"redact\":[\"email\",\"phone\",\"ip\"],\"format\":\"jsonl\"}' \
  -o export.json
```
Preview line in docs: `{"name":"user.authenticated","tenant":"t-4444","time":"2026-05-05T08:00:00Z","attrs":{"pseudonym_id":"pid-1234","location":"[redacted]"}}`
Docs Bot: linkcheck: the draft links to /policy/evidence-playbook on staging and that currently 404s.
Rosa Kim: ok I'll update the link to /docs/evidence-playbook-v1 and include the export API section.
Legal - Compliance: approve pending the fixed link and the export example showing redaction behavior. Also suggest adding: "Customers requiring extended retention should coordinate with Sales and Legal to document the change in their contract."
Priya Shah: one more ask: add a short migration snippet for the server side to map old keys to new ones, maybe show a tiny Python example. That helps integrators upgrade without downtime.
Nikhil Agarwal: added this to the PR:
```py
# compatibility shim
def get_event(payload):
    return payload.get('name') or payload.get('audit_name')
```
and a note to send the deprecation header when `audit_name` is present.
Rosa Kim: I'll push the amended commit in ~20m, fix the broken link, and tag @Legal - Compliance and @Samir for a final pass. After merge we'll run `npm run linkcheck` and add the PR to the release notes. Thanks! :raised_hands:
